acceptance: Require name, type, machine_id, rpc_server_addr and detail. Type string selects memory or file; unknown type fails. Omit empty rdma_server_name; missing value makes nicPathServerName use name.

Require buffers, devices and device_attrs; topology is a JSON string containing topology JSON. Missing topology or transport_attrs is accepted. Non-string numeric map keys encode as arrays of [key,value] pairs.
Require buffers; each FileBufferDesc has path, uint64 length and offset. Preserve nonzero offset in the document.

Encode addr, length, location, transports, regions, transport_attrs, rkey, shm_path, mnnvl_handle and internal. Native transport enums encode as integers. Never serialize ref_count, lkey or permission.
Each region has size and location; order preserves the tiling of its parent buffer.
Require name, lid, gid and transport_attrs. Preserve a numeric transport key and its string value.
Decode the inner nics/mems object. NIC fields: name, pci_bus_id, type, numa_node and optional device_attrs. Memory fields: name, pci_bus_id, type, numa_node and ordered device_list/rankN arrays.
getLocalJson publishes a cached immutable dump. Compare the decoded document; JSON object member order and numeric map iteration order have no semantic significance.
Publish, get and remove under mooncake/tent/ plus the segment name. Value is the SegmentDesc JSON document; malformed or missing entries cannot become valid descriptors.
etcd/redis/http require matching compiled plugin. Preserve Redis database and credential precedence without recording values; real service acceptance is deferred to optional S18.
Look up the peer by segment name via GetSegmentDesc; an empty response is InvalidEntry. Subscribe and invalidate by name on updates.
Pair flattened ordered QPN vectors positionally, retain separate notify QPN and validate peer GID and reply_msg. A QP pool is local configuration, absent from the bootstrap envelope.
Parse the nested endpoint attribute string: protocol, version, incarnation, ordered hosts/ports and max_transfer_bytes. Invalid protocol, address metadata or zero size cannot authorize a connection.
Decode the registration ID and global_read_only/global_read_write permission with protocol/version. Reject a zero registration or an unknown permission.
JSON includes version, provider, virt_addr and NIC entries with hex-encoded address, name and NUMA. Decode NUL and non-ASCII address bytes losslessly.
Decode contiguous chunks with off, len, nics and parallel 64-bit keys. Reject holes, bad indices and incomplete coverage.
Publish version-prefixed host:port from the segment host and the actual MPComm port; decode the accepted unprefixed form and reject a malformed prefix or port.
shm_path names the shared file. The frozen SHM registration omits shm_offset from BufferDesc; OrbiTE's offset-bearing Describe is a separate codec.
Legacy GPU IPC exports serialized handle bytes in shm_path. Keep the raw OrbiTE IPC handle descriptor separate.
Fabric allocation publishes serialized handle bytes in mnnvl_handle. A peer import cannot infer fabric reachability from the segment address.
Keep the dedicated bootstrap envelope and separate generation fields. Recognize the reserved RPC without implementing UB.
Native declarations are stubs returning NotImplemented. No fabricated export token or successful import.
